0.x: The **Bhakti movement was started by the Alvar (and Nayanar) saints** of the Tamil South, **6th-9th c.**

The **first Vaishnava devotees of South India = Alvars**, the composers of the Nalayira Divya Prabandham; **pasurams (pasuras)** = their Tamil hymns **in praise of Vishnu**. **Nayanars = Shaivites**; their hymns on Shiva form the Tevaram.
Both came from **all castes**, even "untouchables" (Panars, Pulaiyars), and were critical of Buddhism and Jainism.

r: Lives of the 63 Nayanars – by **Sekkizhar** under **Kulottunga II** (12th Tirumurai)
Hymns of Appar, Sambandar, Sundarar – the **earliest and most sacred** part (books 1–7) of the Tirumurai
**Rajaraja I** consecrated bronzes of all **63 Nayanmars at Chidambaram**; Parantaka I had installed statues of Appar, Sambandar and Sundarar

0.x: Alvars = Vishnu, 12, Divya Prabandham (pasurams); Nayanars = Shiva, 63, Tevaram/Tirumurai.
